definitions.explanation: A family unit consisting of parents and their children only, without extended family members such as grandparents. A sociological term that has become common in everyday Japanese.

examples.japanese: {核家族|かくかぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
うち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{核家族|かくかぞく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: Our family is a nuclear family; our grandparents live separately.

examples.japanese: {核家族|かくかぞく}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧ことで、⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: As nuclear families became more common, the burden of childcare became concentrated on the parents.

notes:
USAGE:
{核家族|かくかぞく} is contrasted with ⟦{大家族|だいかぞく}→大家族：19696_daikazoku⟧ (extended family) or {三世代同居|さんせだいどうきょ} (three generations living together). The trend toward {核家族|かくかぞく} has been a major social change in postwar Japan.

COMPOUNDS:
- {核家族|かくかぞく}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: the trend toward nuclear families
- {核家族|かくかぞく}⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧: nuclear family household

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大家族|だいかぞく}→大家族：19696_daikazoku⟧: large/extended family
